The first release of **sst-community**, a community-maintained fork of [SST](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst). It is based on upstream [v4.17.1](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/releases/tag/v4.17.1) and adds the changes below.

### Fixes

- **`sst dev` no longer loses responses after a function has been idle, or on cold starts.** Before forwarding an invocation, the dev bridge now checks that its AppSync subscription is delivering, and reconnects if it isn't. This also fixes a double reconnect, and a concurrent map access that could crash the bridge. ([anomalyco/sst#6575](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6575))
- **Removing or redeploying one stage no longer breaks `sst dev` in the others.** Every stage in an account and region shares one dev bridge zip in S3. It's now retained, rather than deleted by whichever stage goes first, which left the rest failing with `NoSuchKey`.

### Changes

- The `sst dev` UI tags each function's log lines with its name and gives concurrent invocations distinct colors.
- `sst version` and the `sst dev` banner show `(sst-community)`.
- Telemetry is turned off.
- `sst upgrade`, `sst init` and the install script use this fork's releases and npm package.

### Install

```bash
npm install sst@npm:@sst-community/sst@4.17.2
```

To switch an existing project, set its dependency to `"sst": "npm:@sst-community/sst@4.17.2"` and reinstall. Without Node:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sst-community/sst/main/install | bash
```
